name: Sensual Black Lace Bodystocking
description:
Made for slow evenings, this black lace bodystocking turns one garment into a complete look — nothing to match, nothing to layer, nothing left to decide. The sensual open mesh wraps shoulder to thigh in a single piece, with the lace pattern handling the artful parts.

It is a full-set mesh outfit: pull it on and the outfit question for the night is answered. Black photographs the way you want it to, under warm light and flash alike, and the one-size cut is recommended for 40–70 kg (about 88–154 lb).

For variety, wear it under a slip dress and let the mesh show through the fabric — a two-layer look that costs one garment.

The rundown:

  • Material: lace
  • Piece: full-set bodystocking, one piece
  • Features: sensual open mesh
  • Color: black
  • Size: one size, recommended for 40–70 kg (about 88–154 lb)
short_description: Sensual black lace bodystocking — full-set open mesh in one piece, one size for 40–70 kg, made for slow evenings.
